subject.title: Multi-agent orchestration is unstable: concurrent agents add/config overwrites, session-lock failures, and detached child work

question: Should this issue remain the canonical multi-agent orchestration umbrella while focused fixes land, or should maintainers replace it with narrower canonical root-cause trackers now?
rationale: The bug class is real, but the permanent fix spans session ownership, delivery guarantees, fallback behavior, provider failover, and cancellation semantics that automation should not choose as a single broad repair.

options.title: Keep Umbrella While Landing Focused Fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open, review focused PRs such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86540 individually, and close only after linked symptoms are resolved or explicitly split.

options.title: Promote Completion Isolation Design
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96975 the canonical product direction and map the remaining bug reports to that design before closing this umbrella.

options.title: Split By Root Cause
options.body: Choose one canonical issue for each unresolved root cause, preserve this issue's production evidence there, and then close the umbrella as superseded.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella While Landing Focused Fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, review focused PRs such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86540 individually, and close only after linked symptoms are resolved or explicitly split.
